body:
Measured across 30 SPA routes x 5 themes x 390/1440, plus a narrow pass at
320/360/430. Horizontal page overflow is **zero everywhere except two routes at
320px**:

    /duplicates  scrollWidth 351 vs viewport 320  (31px past)
    /admin       scrollWidth 322 vs viewport 320  ( 2px past)

Culprits, measured in-page:

- `/duplicates` — `.scanBtn` ("Scan for duplicates") is `white-space: nowrap`
  (inherited from the `Button` primitive's `.btn`) and lays out at 151px wide,
  right edge 352. A single unbreakable label is the whole overflow.
- `/admin` — the per-user `.userActions` / `.deleteBtn` column reaches 323.
  Marginal, but it is real and it is the same width bucket.

Both are narrow-width-only; 360, 390, 430 and 1440 are all clean, as is every
other route. Worth doing in one pass with F-5a225c (the hamburger's glyph
collapsing at the same 320px), since both are the top bar / narrow-layout story
rather than component styling.

Method + full inventory: `notes/UI-SWEEP-INVENTORY.md` (outer workspace).
title: Two routes overflow horizontally at 320px
